notes:
Passed the fake-backend acceptance gate (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); it is R1, so the loader does not apply the R2/R3 reviewed-by refusal, but the hardware backend was never run. The hardware factory .native:connect is the only live path: it imports sls.client.Detector and needs the upstream sls-detector package installed plus the detector host and optional ctrl/stop ports; deployment requires validation. The upstream simulator is a gevent/scipy TCP server and this package must not run clone code, so the gate uses the package's in-memory analytic stand-in .fake:FakeDetector, which is not a recording and does not replay traffic. Fake start values, the 5 ms per-frame pacing cap and the 16-element frame are placeholders, not facts: a full Mythen II frame is 7680 counts (6 modules x 10 chips x 128 channels per the clone layout comment). NOT COVERED: earlier frames of a multi-frame acquisition (acquire returns only the last frame), the full 7680-count frame in the fake, the upstream binary wire protocol, and the upstream simulator. The six writable parameters (energy_threshold, exposure_time, nb_frames, nb_cycles, frame_period, delay_after_trigger) have no stated numeric range in the clone, so every write is Limit.operator_required and is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until site-limits.json supplies the range; site-limits.example.json is only an example, not a device statement. The task card's sls/shm.py MAX_* hints are shared-memory validation array capacities, not device limits, and are not used. The e-stop and the safe-state action both call Detector.stop_acquisition() (STOP_ACQUISITION on the separate stop port); the stop reply is an acknowledgement, the driver reports the run_status read after it and does not claim an independently sensed quiescence, and the fake proves only that path on the fake, never the physical stop. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the direct Driver against sls/client.py, sls/protocol.py and sls/shm.py, the python-object reroute (the tag-bridge report's Detector client with a stop port) and every fact; the stop, STOP_ACQUISITION on the stop port, is acknowledged by request_reply (a FAIL reply raises). Defects: the upstream Detector shares one Connection per port and every call reconnects it, while reads do not take the driver lock, so a state read during acquire reconnected the control socket the acquisition reads its frames from (the thread-safe fake hid it); four facts said more than their lines (a fixed 7680-count frame, a cross-file 'documents as ALL', a whole-clone 'no validation', close() outside the range). The reviewer made the ten control-port reads return no value while acquire runs, close the upstream generator in a finally, corrected and added facts (no socket timeouts, the _stopped semantics, frame size from data_bytes, the 8-bit '<i' decode), and changed driver.py, test_driver.py (reads during acquire; an e-stop during acquire through the server) and facts.md, regenerating reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate and strict collect pass, digest unchanged (sha256:e10b6f4003319b4134c56dccd69ef97676be77bf841565eafaf70c2fbbcc336d). Stale author text: the RESULT.json notes give a full frame as 7680 counts. Not a predicted block: the package follows the report's reroute. For the human reviewer: A detector (R1): the stop ends acquisition only. The upstream sockets have no timeout, so a detector that accepts the connection but never answers leaves the e-stop unacknowledged (reported SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, latch held), and a stop-port read overlapping the e-stop can make it report unreached and retry. Frames read at dynamic range 8 are decoded upstream with a 4-byte dtype. The Lima Tango class and the simulator are not covered. Licence: the clone has no LICENSE file; MIT is stated only in packaging metadata (setup.py:65), while the card says MIT with publish_review not_required.
